content: Go color detection priority: 1) App-specific flags (--no-color/--color). 2) NO_COLOR env var (any value = disable). 3) CLICOLOR_FORCE (enable even in pipe). 4) isatty check on stdout fd. fatih/color auto-disables when NO_COLOR is set and when stdout is not a TTY (piped). go-supportscolor checks FORCE_COLOR=0/1/2/3. lipgloss strips all color when not TTY. Standard: check term.IsTerminal(int(os.Stdout.Fd())) and os.Getenv("NO_COLOR").
